page.overview:
Who is Temaile Kinderode?

Temaile Kinderode was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

She was a fox-faced Cairhienin with very big blue eyes and shoulder-length dark hair. She was 5'2" (158 cm) in height and appeared fragile, like a pretty child.

Despite her innocent appearance, she was a complete sadist and enjoyed hurting people physically and emotionally.

Temaile has a One Power strength of . This is relatively strong for an Aes Sedai.
